title: Comercio imperial
goal: Read about the convoy system built to protect Spain's silver from pirates, the contraband trade that may have rivaled it, and the annual voyage that first connected Asia and the Americas.

items: Explain how the fleet system worked and why it existed.
Explain how large contraband trade became relative to legal trade.
Describe what the Manila Galleon connected and what it exchanged.
Explain what happened to Acapulco when the galleon arrived.
Use 'a lo largo de' and 'como consecuencia de' to structure a trade-history paragraph.
